sources.title: Candidates for New James Bond Director Include Denis Villeneuve, Edgar Wright, and Paul King: Report
highlights:
andidates for New James Bond Director Include Denis Villeneuve, Edgar Wright, and Paul King: Report Scoop Harrison 

June 20, 2025 \| 8:10am ET

 Add Consequence on Google The search for the next James Bond director is underway, according to a new report from Matt Beloni of Puck News. For now, the idea of Christopher Nolan taking the reins of 007 remains a fantasy, as the acclaimed auteur is still tied up with the _Odyssey_ and has no meeting scheduled with producers David Heyman and Amy Pascal. But some pretty formidable names _do_, including Denis Villeneuve ( _Dune_), Edward Berger ( _Conclave_, _All Quiet on the Western Front_), Edgar Wright ( _Baby Driver_, _Scott Pilgrim_), Paul King ( _Paddington_, _Wonka_), and Jonathan Nolan ( _Westworld_, _Fallout_). The hope, per Belloni, is “to set the director this summer, then get the script written, _then_ cast the next Bond.” Load More

highlights: The reported shortlist for the next James Bond director has been revealed – and it has me feeling excited and terrified about the future of 007 in equal measure. According to Puck , Shaun of the Dead's Edgar Wright, Dune's Denis Villeneuve, Conclave's Edward Berger, Paddington's Paul King, and Fallout and Westworld's Jonathan Nolan – brother of Christopher – are in line to pitch their take on MI6's finest. Among them, Berger has purportedly delivered his ideas to new Bond bosses Amy Pascal and ... Of course, it's hard not to get a little hot under the tuxedo collar at the thought of the likes of Villeneuve or ... gate) behind the camera. The rest of the field, too, either strikes the right sort of quaint Britishness (King), fizzy action (Wright), or a ... The issue is, though, that this Bond _has_ to work. Now that long-time stewards Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson have stepped aside after selling up to Amazon , there's a lot of pressure on getting the tone right. Could we have a 1960s-inspired spy caper? Or a hard-hitting Bond? Will 007 embrace camp or chaos? Either could work, ... Of course, Bond is a broad church. This is the franchise that has had one 007's allies be chomped by sharks and, a few films prior, featured a battle in outer space. But this is, arguably, the biggest decision in the series' long and ... Personally, I would have played it very safe and once again brought Martin Campbell back into the fold after he kicked ... But I'm not paid the big bucks at Amazon. From the shortlist alone, it seems like Pascal and Heyman can't make a _bad_ choice – but they need to get the director right and, hopefully, the rest will slot into place. Otherwise the, ahem, _spectre_ of starting off on the wrong foot could haunt James Bond for years to come. We have our own picks – for your eyes only, naturally – for who should play 007. Discover more in our guide to the next James Bond , then also dive into all the latest on upcoming video game 007 First Light .
